Sasha (PM): Quick idea — let's define an 'onboarding footprint' for design partners / betas so we can set clear expectations (time, integration, data, support) and map the signals we need to measure success. I can sketch a template if folks agree.

Tessa (Design): yes please. a short template would help standardize asks across partners. can we keep it one page? :+1:

Ben (Eng): +1. also want to capture infra needs (staging capacity, API keys, model variants). otherwise ops surprises.

Devon (Research): important to tie signals to what we actually care about: adoption (weekly active flows), quality (regression rate), and product fit (qual feedback). i can propose thresholds.

Aisha (CS): i'll own recruitment segments (enterprise vs startup vs research labs) and what incentives to offer. we should include an expected response SLAs matrix (e.g., CS will respond within 48h).

Sasha (PM): rough sketch below — please react with comments and volunteers to own each section. i'll make a doc after this thread.

```
Onboarding Footprint (1p template)
- Commitment: dev hours per week, PM/ops weekly sync cadence
- Integration surface: API keys, sample data, webhooks, UI embedding scope
- Data & security: data types, retention, PII guardrails, NDA needed?
- Support: CS contact, escalation path, expected response SLA
- Success window: 6 weeks (pilot) / 12 weeks (deeper pilot)

Signals -> Success criteria (examples)
- Engagement: weekly-active-tests >= 5 per partner -> consider engaged
- Retention: 4/6 weeks active -> pilot continuation candidate
- Performance: median response latency < 250ms (p90 < 400ms) -> perf-ok
- Quality: semantic-regression-rate < 5% (vs baseline eval) -> quality-ok
- Qual: average partner NPS >= 6 across 3 check-ins -> good fit
```

Tessa (Design): i suggest adding a small checklist for onboarding UX (sample prompts, edge cases to test, privacy banners). i'll add checkboxes in the doc.

Ben (Eng): for the perf thresholds we need to define test harness: e.g., synthetic load with realistic token lengths. also tag partners in staging with `dp=true` so we can filter metrics. infra-bot, can you create a tag?

infra-bot: Created metric tag `dp=true` in staging namespace.

Devon (Research): on quality/regression — we should surface per-prompt deltas, not just aggregate. propose a small eval suite (10 prompts) that we run each week and track drift. i can author the suite.

Aisha (CS): recruitment note — prefer 60/40 split enterprise:startups for first 8 partners so we can see variance. will propose a shortlist by Tue.

Sasha (PM): thanks all. i'll create the doc now and drop a link. please add owners to each line item: integration, metrics, eval suite, recruitment. target: comments by EOD Friday so we can include this in next roadmap sync. :rocket:

Sasha (PM): doc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-example-onboarding-footprint (internal)

Tessa (Design): i'll add the UX checklist & a short consent copy snippet.

Ben (Eng): i'll add staging test plan and capacity notes.

Devon (Research): will upload initial eval prompts and thresholds.

Aisha (CS): will share shortlist and outreach templates.

Sasha (PM): perfect. if anyone thinks the success windows (6/12w) are off, flag now. otherwise we'll lock and run a 6-week pilot funnel.

Ben (Eng): 6 weeks is fine for early scope, but call out that infra SLOs might need the 12-week window if we require heavy data ingest.

Sasha (PM): noted. i added a line to the template for expected data volume buckets.

infra-bot: Document updated by Sasha (PM)

Aisha (CS): volunteers for outreach help? @Tessa @Devon?

Tessa (Design): happy to help with outreach messaging and screenshots.

Devon (Research): can help on the messaging for research labs and open-source teams.

Sasha (PM): great — i'll assign tasks in the doc. thanks everyone.
